name: background-stripes
summary: Repeating stripe pattern as a background, optionally over an image.

arguments.name: $color
accepts: one colour, or several for a multi-stripe pattern

arguments.name: $thickness
accepts: stripe thickness: a length, or var(), env() or a calculation such as calc() or clamp()

arguments.name: $rotation
accepts: an angle; a unitless number is treated as degrees

arguments.name: $image
accepts: an image path to sit behind the stripes
var(), url(), image-set() or a gradient, written as they are rather than wrapped in url()
